description.narrative:
The overall objective for WIN 2.0 is "To increase women's economic empowerment (WEE) in Mozambique by identifying, catalyzing, and scaling systemic solutions that benefit low-income women". WIN analyses and tracks WEE using seven different dimensions. These are collected by intervention, depending on which dimensions are the most relevant and most targeted by the intervention in question. WIN's main indicator is based on the central dimension, income and assets, which is also aggregated quantitatively across all interventions. An improvement in WEE is counted when a woman increases her earned income and/or increases her secure assets such as savings kept in a formal financial institution.
WIN works across what is called "verticals", representing supporting functions as well as rules and norms in the market system.
Women in Business (WIN) fas 2 syftar till att stärka kvinnors ekonomiska egenmakt i Mocambique, genom att arbeta med kvinnliga mikroentreprenörer.

Women in Business second phase - WIN 2 - aims at increasing women's economic empowerment in Mozambique through taking on a markets systems development approach and targeting female micro entrepreneurs.

description.narrative:
The social unrest after the elections in October 2024 caused delays in relation to planned activities (limitations to carry out field work for 4-5 months), but TechnoServe are working to conclude the pending activities/processes. The implementation is still focusing on developing the conditions to achieve the long- term objective. Progress is mainly related to established partnership or processes. At output level following was achieved during 2024: *Amount of finance or investment mobilized in support of initiatives to benefit women - USD 120,000 * Number of partners working with the program in a way that benefits women - 10
Regarding how the processes proceed, it is assessed that they are developing more or less according to plan. The aim with a Market System Development (MSD) intervention is to obtain sustainable results at end of the intervention. Usually there is no linear achievement of results over the project period, it is more of a gradual increase with a spike at the end. With the extension until 2027 the results framework was updated and the planned results were increased, but also push forward towards the end of the project period. It is foreseen that first results will be obtained at end of 2025.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
